blocks.text: savefig writes the figure to a file. Choose a format and size appropriate for how it will be used.

blocks.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(["Books", "Pens"], [2, 3])
fig.savefig("practice-chart.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)
blocks.title: Save a figure to a file

blocks.text: A PNG image is saved in the current working directory. Closing the figure releases its resources.
